set.body:
Objective

Express ER-RSA hypotheses as rectangular query matrices H rather than a new analysis class.

Primary ownership

New pair-query constructors, query validation/compiler integration, documentation, and oracle tests.

Deliverables

- match_coupling(), control_coupling(), and pair_contrast() convenience values.
- pair_lm_query() compiling coefficient rows from explicit weighted pair-space designs.
- Optional encoding-item and retrieval-item nuisance effects in the pair design.
- Diagnostics report row/column balance of the final H; match_control() does not overclaim invariance after downstream weighting.
- Support unequal axes, missing matches, repeated retrievals, restricted eligible edges, sparse H, nuisance terms, and rank checks.

Acceptance

Compiled coefficients equal explicit weighted least-squares oracles; H with zero row/column marginals cancels arbitrary additive baselines exactly; the known diag(a)Q column-leak counterexample remains a regression test; rank-deficient or infeasible designs fail clearly; one unequal-axis ER workflow composes partition edges, edge operation, and H without an ER model class.

Non-goals

No pair-edge independence assumption, group inference, or automatic balanced optimal-transport solver in this delivery.
set.title: Compile match-control and pair-space GLM queries
